_about: Every third-party or SATOM-owned browser asset SATOM Builder serves, vendored so an offline install renders exactly like an online one. Nothing the Builder loads in a browser comes from another origin. Upgrading an asset: copy it byte-identical, update its entry and digest here; tests/test_static_assets.py checks every digest.
